title: Kato
overview: This film explores the sensations and associative memories of childhood. It delves into how a simple object—its touch or its scent—can transport someone back to their childhood, recalling a specific day that might seem ordinary yet is charged with intense emotion. The narrative captures the essence of care, fear, love, warmth, aggression, stress, and the subtle forms of violence that a child might not understand at the time, or might understand but be unable to articulate.
